summary: Two admin-only control API additions for the model test bench (ADR-0146, ADR-0147, proposed). B2: GET /admin/roles is registered on the control app only; basic_auth_middleware covers every path outside /v1/, so it needs the admin login and router.admin_networks like /admin/config (tested: 401 before the handler without a login); GET only, no PUT. It returns a strict subset of GET /admin/config's roles (exposed_as, tier model, num_ctx, cloud provider name), no system_append prompts, options, canary, shadow, clients or nodes, with Cache-Control no-store; no data that /admin/config did not already give the same caller. POST /admin/measure: the optional contexts list is validated before a node is chosen or anything is spawned (1-6 distinct ints, bool excluded, 2048..1048576; 400 otherwise); on a node without GPU values a request with contexts is refused (409) instead of silently measuring only 8k/32k. B3/TM-08: each listed context is one more unload+load on the chosen free node under the existing single-measurement lock (state.MEASURING) and node.inflight, so measurements stay serialized; a very large context may spill into RAM, which the catalog marks as partial_offload as before - the admin asks for it explicitly, as when setting a role's num_ctx. Requests without contexts follow the previous path unchanged (tested). No new dependency, configuration key or protocol field.

tests.evidence: 5 tests: contexts join fixed and role contexts, cloud tiers excluded, no-contexts unchanged; malformed lists (empty, duplicate, out of range, strings, floats, bools, scalar, too many) refused with 400 and nothing spawned; node without GPU values refused for contexts (409), measured by /api/ps without; roles listing equals /admin/config roles reduced, no prompts/options; GET-only route; 401 without login before the handler. Without the router change: 1 failure, 13 errors.

tests.command: selftest_vram_real, selftest_admin_networks, selftest_memory, ruff, check_control_flow, check_adr_index
every python test/... and tools/... command of all workflows (Windows)
tests.evidence: 106 commands, 1 failed: lock_requirements.py outdated refuses Windows by design (passes on Linux).

limitations: Not measured on a real GPU node: the measurement path itself (_measure_real) is unchanged apart from the extra contexts and is covered by selftest_vram_real; the test bench's own switch to the new options is not part of this repository.
The model test bench's wish for a fact 'model unloaded and process RAM freed' is not addressed here: it needs the agent to report runner process memory (protocol change) and is proposed separately.
